content.text: Gonzaga UniversityExploreGonzaga UniversityGonzaga University is a comprehensive private, liberal arts college dedicated to the Jesuit, Catholic and humanistic ideals of educating the mind, body and spirit to foster people for others. Located in Spokane, Washington, Gonzaga is a vital part of the metropolitan area which includes 721,000 people and serves as the medical, financial and cultural center of the Inland Northwest. gonzaga.edu/beazagAcademic ProgramsArt & DesignBusinessClassical CivilizationsCommunicationComputer ScienceComputer ScienceEconomicsEducationEngineeringEnvironmental StudiesFinance/AccountingFrenchGovernment/Political ScienceHealth ScienceHuman PhysiologyInternational StudiesItalianKinesiologyLiberal ArtsMathMusicNursingPerforming ArtsPharmacyPhilosophyPre-DentalPre-LawPre-MedPre-Physical TherapyPsychologyPublic healthReligious StudiesScienceSocial ScienceSpanishSport ManagmentVisual ArtsStudent experienceAthleticsCo-op/Internship OpportunitiesCommunity ServiceDisability ServicesDiversity & InclusionIntramural/Club SportsLGBTQIA ServicesLeadership DevelopmentMilitary/Veteran ServicesOn-Campus HousingROTC ProgramReligious AffiliationStudy AbroadUndergraduate ResearchVeteran Fee WaiverApplication informationFind out about requirements, fees, and deadlinesFirst-yearGonzaga takes a holistic approach to admission by carefully considering the following criteria: curriculum and school, grade point average and grade trends, optional SAT or ACT scores, college essay, activities, and character. As a first-year applicant for admission, you are expected to graduate from an accredited high school with a college preparatory curriculum while showing evidence of ability to complete the University's requirements for graduation. Students with college credit taken BEFORE high school graduation (e.g. Running Start) should apply as a First-Year student. Home-schooled students are also invited to apply. gonzaga.edu/admissionreqsTransferThe Transfer Application is intended for students who have graduated high school and have enrolled in college coursework following high school graduation. Apply directly through Gonzaga’s website at https://apply.gonzaga.edu/apply/. Completion of 30 semester/45 quarter credits from a regionally accredited institution is recommended. Applicants should have a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.7 at the college level; first-year transfers must also meet high school admission requirements. In addition, the most recent coursework should be completed with a 2.7 GPA or higher prior to transfer. Finally, applicants should have maintained good standing at the current or most recent institution attended. Additional InformationGonzaga offers excellent academic opportunities with over 75 undergraduate academic programs, 16 master’s degrees, 5 doctoral-level degrees, and a School of Law. Additionally, undergraduates may participate in several distinctive academic programs.At Gonzaga, we strive to help every student achieve their fullest potential. That means providing opportunities through scholarship and financial aid to make a Gonzaga education more accessible. 99% of first-year Gonzaga students receive merit scholarships and/or grants.A Gonzaga education is an excellent investment with successful outcomes. With a 95% success rate (students employed, attending graduate school or in the Military or volunteer programs, 6-months after graduation, 2021-2023), you are prepared for your next adventure. We hope you apply to #BeAZag!Visit usVisiting our campus is the best way to get to know Gonzaga. We want your visit to Gonzaga to meet your interests and needs, so we offer a variety of options, including campus tours, admission interviews, class visits & faculty meetings, overnight visits, Preview Days, Engineering Days, and Nursing Fridays. To learn more and schedule a visit, contact our Visit Office at 1.800.322.2584, ext. 6531, visit@gonzaga.edu, or schedule online at www.gonzaga.edu/visit. We look forward to having you on campus!The real measure of our Jesuit universities lies in who our students become.
